exposure: Mothers with GDM vs. mothers without GDM
cohort: Live-born singletons, born at 34 0/7 to 36 6/7 weeks
finding: The study found no significant difference in the incidence of RDS or TTN between infants born to mothers with and without GDM, suggesting that GDM itself is not a major contributor to RDS in late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with RDS and TTN in late pre-term infants.
